title: Engineering titles minus managers and contractors
prompt: Return the name (column: name) of staff whose title contains 'Engineer' or contains 'Developer', excluding anyone whose title contains 'Manager', and excluding anyone whose email ends with '@contractor.com'.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE staff (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, title TEXT, email TEXT); INSERT INTO staff VALUES (1,'Tom Reyes','Software Engineer','tom@company.com'),(2,'Julia Park','Engineering Manager','julia@company.com'),(3,'Sam Osei','Senior Developer','sam@contractor.com'),(4,'Nora Kim','Frontend Developer','nora@company.com'),(5,'Leo Grant','QA Engineer','leo@company.com'),(6,'Ivy Chan','Product Manager','ivy@company.com'),(7,'Max Fields','Backend Engineer','max@contractor.com');
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM staff WHERE (title LIKE '%Engineer%' OR title LIKE '%Developer%') AND title NOT LIKE '%Manager%' AND email NOT LIKE '%@contractor.com';
